name: Irrationality of ζ(9): weighted lattice route

draft_items.theorem_title: Two independent small integer forms imply irrationality
draft_items.natural_language_statement: Let x be real. If, for every positive tolerance, there are two integer coefficient pairs with nonzero determinant and both corresponding forms b+a x have absolute value below that tolerance, then x is irrational. This is the general mathematical criterion used at node P; it does not construct the pairs for ζ(9).
draft_items.source: Local ζ(9) research, round6/research/analytic.md §5 and roadmap/DAG.md §J to root; mathematical proof in notes, Lean statement only in this draft.

draft_items.theorem_title: Eventual volume bound and vanishing shape imply an exponential margin
draft_items.natural_language_statement: For arbitrary real sequences B and σ, suppose B(2k+2) is eventually at most some β<2641/250 and σ(2k+2) tends to zero. Then some positive ε gives B(2k+2)+σ(2k+2)≤2641/250−ε for all sufficiently large k. This is the abstract V+S⇒J bridge; it does not establish those hypotheses for the concrete ζ(9) sequences.
draft_items.source: Local ζ(9) roadmap/DAG.md §V and S to J; mathematical proof in notes, Lean statement only in this draft.

draft_items.natural_language_statement: The real part of the Riemann zeta function at the complex number 9 is irrational. At this positive integer it is the classical real value ζ(9)=∑_{k≥1}k^(−9). This is the open mission goal.
draft_items.source: Classical open single-value irrationality problem; see W. Zudilin, Arithmetic of linear forms involving odd zeta values, arXiv:math/0206176, and local ζ(9) roadmap/DAG.md §J to root.

milestones.milestone_description: Formalize the established result that at least one of ζ(5), ζ(7), ζ(9), ζ(11) is irrational. It is a historical lower bound on what the current methods identify and does not imply the single-value mission goal. This item reuses the platform's existing open theorem.

Formalize the note-proved criterion converting arbitrarily small values of two independent integer forms into irrationality. In the proposed ζ(9) route, this criterion is applied only after the second-minimum and analytic estimates produce those two forms.

milestones.milestone_title: Abstract volume and shape margin bridge
milestones.milestone_description: Formalize the checked logical step from an eventual volume rate strictly below 10.564 and vanishing shape defect to a uniform positive margin. The concrete V and S estimates remain open mathematical research targets, not hypotheses established by this milestone.
